case_boundary: The runner executes pinned PDFium CPDF_Page::UpdateDimensions and GetPageWidth/GetPageHeight with host-supplied page dictionary values, then original FPDFPage_NewFormObj instructions from +0x50 to +0x104. Page-handle dispatch, document/XObject construction, complete Samsung writer, PDF serialization and rendering are excluded. Each page_rotation_quarter_turn is distinct from the OpenWriter form argument 4-page_rotation; PDFium normalizes the latter modulo 4 to select the captured matrix. Candidate top-left point outputs compose the matrix with a host-supplied point and host-side H-y arithmetic using the actual native GetPageHeight result after UpdateDimensions has applied source rotation. Source page dictionary values and point remain host-supplied; the point/matrix composition is host-side, not a native full-write capture.
